About Bond

Regional knowledge. Global coordination.

Bond Group is a diversified group of companies serving the commodity trading and shipping sectors. Our teams connect supply resources across Asia, the Middle East, Europe and Africa.

  • Marine fuel supply at strategic global ports
  • Market insight from teams in Singapore, China, the UAE and Iraq
  • More than ten years of offshore oil supply experience
